start.title: [TODO:pl] By the Shore
start.text:
[TODO:pl] The Teacher steps from the boat.
Your daughter is dying at home.

servant_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] Go Yourself
servant_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] No one else can carry your hope.
Kneel before him.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] Open Your Heart
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] He already sees your sorrow.
Speak it aloud.

plea.title: [TODO:pl] Come, Lay Your Hand
plea.text:
[TODO:pl] "My little daughter is dying.
Come, and she will live."

journey.title: [TODO:pl] Through the Crowd
journey.text:
[TODO:pl] Streets press tight. He stops walking.
Minutes feel like years.

push_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] He Knows the Hour
push_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] His pace is mercy, not delay.
Stand close.

news.title: [TODO:pl] She Is Dead
news.text:
[TODO:pl] A servant arrives, eyes wet.
"Trouble the Teacher no more."

despair_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] Only Believe
despair_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] His voice steadies your knees.
"Do not fear. Only believe."

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] He Hears You
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] His eyes hold no offense.
Only invitation.

encourage.title: [TODO:pl] Do Not Fear
encourage.text:
[TODO:pl] "Do not be afraid. Only believe."
His hand rests on your shoulder.

room.title: [TODO:pl] The Quiet Room
room.text:
[TODO:pl] Mourners wail. He sends them out.
"She is only sleeping."

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:pl] Be Still
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] His calm answers your doubt.
Watch him.

raise.title: [TODO:pl] Talitha Koum
raise.text:
[TODO:pl] He takes her small hand.
"Little girl, I say, arise."

joy.title: [TODO:pl] She Rises
joy.text:
[TODO:pl] She sits up, breathing, smiling.
He says, "Give her something to eat."
